objective: 在保留 SPDX 产物与来源证明输入的同时，让标签触发的 SBOM 生成保持最小权限。
acceptance: release workflow retains contents read instead of granting contents write
SBOM generation does not attempt to attach assets to a GitHub Release
the generated SPDX file is retained by the explicit artifact step and remains the provenance manifest input
a deterministic regression test protects the permission boundary
evidence: 发布工作流回归测试输出
来自人工创建的标签或手动分发的 GitHub Actions 结果
stop_conditions: 该修复需要 contents 写权限或发布凭据
需要新的发布或版本标签
不改动运行时镜像就无法生成 SBOM
